input:
Write a bash script that cuts a release.

Starting files:
--- /home/eval/app/VERSION ---
1.9.3
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/changes.txt ---
fix: handle empty config
feat: add --dry-run flag
docs: typo in README
fix: retry on 503
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md ---
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
--- end ---

1. Decide the bump from /home/eval/app/changes.txt: if any line starts with `BREAKING` or has `!:` right after its type (e.g. `feat!: ...`), bump major; otherwise if any line starts with `feat:`, bump minor; otherwise bump patch. Lower parts reset to 0. Version parts are integers.
2. Write the new version to /home/eval/app/VERSION (single line).
3. In /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md, keep the `## Unreleased` heading and insert right after it: a blank line, the heading `## <new version> (2026-10-09)`, then one line `- <change>` for each `feat`/`fix` line of changes.txt in original order (other types are omitted). The existing blank line before `## 1.9.3` must remain, so the file reads:
```
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.10.0 (2026-10-09)
- fix: handle empty config
- feat: add --dry-run flag
- fix: retry on 503

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
```
4. Print `1.9.3 -> <new version>` to stdout and exit 0.

transcript.final_response:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

app_dir="/home/eval/app"
version_file="$app_dir/VERSION"
changes_file="$app_dir/changes.txt"
changelog_file="$app_dir/CHANGELOG.md"

old_ver=$(head -n 1 "$version_file" | tr -d '\r\n')
IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$old_ver"

bump="patch"
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^BREAKING ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+(\([^)]*\))?!: ]]; then
    bump="major"
    break
  elif [[ "$line" =~ ^feat: ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^feat\([^)]*\): ]]; then
    bump="minor"
  fi
done < "$changes_file"

if [[ "$bump" == "major" ]]; then
  major=$((major + 1))
  minor=0
  patch=0
elif [[ "$bump" == "minor" ]]; then
  minor=$((minor + 1))
  patch=0
else
  patch=$((patch + 1))
fi

new_ver="${major}.${minor}.${patch}"

printf "%s\n" "$new_ver" > "$version_file"

entries=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^(feat|fix)(\([^)]*\))?!?: ]]; then
    entries+=("- $line")
  fi
done < "$changes_file"

tmp_file=$(mktemp)
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmp_file"
  if [[ "$line" == "## Unreleased" ]]; then
    printf '\n## %s (2026-10-09)\n' "$new_ver" >> "$tmp_file"
    for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
      printf '%s\n' "$entry" >> "$tmp_file"
    done
  fi
done < "$changelog_file"

mv "$tmp_file" "$changelog_file"

printf "%s -> %s\n" "$old_ver" "$new_ver"
exit 0
```
